name: Karina's Cantina Gaslamp
notes: Homepage cache had almost no menu content; found a location-specific /gaslamp-quarter/ subpage linking a dated (June 2026) first-party PDF menu. The PDF is image-only (no text layer), so pages were extracted as JPEGs with probe/extract_pdf_images.js and transcribed manually: page 2 is the full food menu (103 dishes across 13 sections), page 1 is a drinks/bar list excluded as an adjunct. Grubhub/Postmates marketplace prices were checked and rejected: dividing them by 1.20 lands cleanly on these same first-party dollar amounts, confirming a ~20% delivery markup rather than genuine menu prices. 'Pescado Frito' (whole fried fish) was dropped because it is priced per-pound with a variable minimum weight, not a fixed price.
